patch.objective: Use the comprehensive geriatric assessment areas -- function, cognition, mood, falls, pain, polypharmacy, nutrition, senses -- for older adults

sources.note: Relayed from the ADN-RN course's earlier cases (read 2026-11-11, primary PDF), not re-read for this band: the pre-licensure RN course is built toward this test plan.
The objective and secondary objectives are the course's own titles.

sources.cite: Tatum PE III, Talebreza S, Ross JS. Geriatric Assessment: An Office-Based Approach. Am Fam Physician 2018;97(12):776-784
sources.note: Relayed from the BSN-RN case eleven-pills-three-falls-sleep-aid, not re-read for this band; its note: Read 2026-11-17 through a summarizing fetch with quotes: geriatric assessment 'addresses functional status, fall risk, medication review, nutrition, vision, hearing, cognition, mood, and toileting'; tools include the Mini-Cog, Timed Up and Go, Beers criteria, PHQ-2 and the Mini Nutritional Assessment; document goals and preferences and a surrogate decision maker.

Relayed from the BSN-RN case eleven-pills-three-falls-sleep-aid, not re-read for this band; its note: Simplified teaching model written for exam practice; not a validated physiological model. Disease courses, effect sizes and local waits are authored and carry FLAG.
